title: Failover Game Day Checklist (Sheet) — Controlled Regional Failover us-east → eu-west
body:
Sheet notes:
- This is a spreadsheet-style run sheet. Fill timestamps in PT unless otherwise specified.
- Default blast radius for this game day: Hosted API (limited routes/models) + 2 Dedicated canary tenants only.
- Use DRY-RUN first. Production execution requires explicit on-call ack (approval hook enabled).
- Rollback authority: Miles Thornton (primary), Rafael Mendes (secondary). If in doubt, rollback.

Key:
- Status values: NOT_STARTED | IN_PROGRESS | DONE | SKIPPED | FAILED
- Evidence: link to dashboard panel screenshot or metric query output (paste URL/text)

Run metadata (fill day-of):
- Game day date:
- Incident channel / coordination channel:
- Incident commander (IC):
- Comms lead:
- Routing operator:
- Observability operator:
- Networking operator:
- Dedicated operator:
- Start time (PT):
- Planned end time (PT):
- Target scenario: us-east impairment + automated failover to eu-west


TABLE (copy/paste-friendly)
| ID | Phase | Task | Owner | Start (PT) | End (PT) | Status | Validation / Query / Link | Notes |
|----|-------|------|-------|------------|----------|--------|----------------------------|-------|
| P0-01 | Pre-flight | Confirm go/no-go criteria met (PRs merged, feature flags staged, dashboard pack deployed) | Rafael Mendes | | | NOT_STARTED | Check release checklist; verify helm values present for failover-controller | Blocking items? |

| P0-03 | Pre-flight | Confirm Dedicated canary tenants consent + internal comms sent | Lauren Bishop | | | NOT_STARTED | CS notes / internal email reference | If any tenant opts out, stop |
| P0-04 | Pre-flight | Confirm status page / comms plan ready (NO external post unless impact observed) | Devon Price | | | NOT_STARTED | Status template ready; incident-bot configured | Link to comms draft |

| P0-06 | Pre-flight | Confirm failover-controller DRY-RUN mode functional in prod | Miles Thornton | | | NOT_STARTED | CLI: failoverctl simulate --region us-east --target eu-west | Output attached |
| P0-07 | Pre-flight | Verify region health inputs present (reachability, 5xx burn, latency burn, capacity, network) | Allison Grant | | | NOT_STARTED | Dashboard: Failover Signals → Inputs healthy; no missing streams | If missing, do not proceed |
| P0-08 | Pre-flight | Networking sanity: DNS TTLs and anycast steering constraints reviewed | Victor Alvarez | | | NOT_STARTED | Validate DNS TTL target; confirm no pending infra change windows | Record provider caveats |
| P0-09 | Pre-flight | Capacity/headroom check in eu-west (Hosted + Dedicated) meets "safe to failover" | Vanessa Ortiz | | | NOT_STARTED | Query: fleet_headroom{region="eu-west"} > threshold | Capture thresholds used |
| P0-10 | Pre-flight | Gateway guardrails: retries/timeouts/circuit breaker config confirmed | Peter Holtz | | | NOT_STARTED | Compare gateway config to baseline; ensure retry-after enabled | Prevent thundering herd |
| P0-11 | Pre-flight | Confirm alert routing + paging hygiene (burn alerts not paging entire org) | Tomáš Novák | | | NOT_STARTED | Verify alert routes; silence non-critical noise | Keep IC focus |
| P0-12 | Pre-flight | Create tracking ticket/comments for timeline notes | Talia Benson | | | NOT_STARTED | Linear ENG-2421 comment stub created | Assign note taker |

| R1-01 | Run | Start coordination thread; declare game day start + scope reminder | Rafael Mendes (IC) | | | NOT_STARTED | Post in #eng-sre + incident channel: scope, rollback triggers | Use template |
| R1-02 | Run | Snapshot baseline metrics (Hosted API + Dedicated): p50/p95/p99, 5xx, saturation | Allison Grant | | | NOT_STARTED | Queries:
- http_5xx_rate{region="us-east"}
- tail_latency_p99{region="us-east"}
- req_rate{region in ("us-east","eu-west")}
- gpu_util{region="eu-west"} | Attach links/screens |

| R1-04 | Run | Verify synthetic probes baseline (cross-region reachability) | Victor Alvarez | | | NOT_STARTED | Probe: reachability{src="global",dst="us-east"} == OK | Record RTT |
| R1-05 | Run | DRY-RUN #1: simulate us-east impairment signals; confirm recommended action | Miles Thornton | | | NOT_STARTED | failoverctl simulate --record --reason "gameday" | Save output (audit id) |
| R1-06 | Run | Confirm DRY-RUN recommends expected policy flip (route to eu-west), no extra flips | Ravi Menon | | | NOT_STARTED | Validate: action_count == 1; affected_routes == allowlist | If unexpected, stop |
| R1-07 | Run | Prepare rollback plan: confirm rollback command + anti-flap timers | Benji Okafor | | | NOT_STARTED | failoverctl rollback --policy <id>; verify hold-down timers shown | Paste timer values |

| E1-01 | Execution | Induce impairment in us-east (per test plan) — OPTION A: drop egress to model gateways for canary routes only | Vikram Singh | | | NOT_STARTED | Change record: ______ ; verify only canary routes impacted | Strict blast radius |
| E1-02 | Execution | Confirm impairment visible in signals: reachability down and/or error burn rising (corroborated) | Allison Grant | | | NOT_STARTED | Dashboard: reachability degraded + 5xx burn > threshold | Must meet ADR-042 corroboration |

| E1-05 | Execution | Execute failover (policy flip) to route canary traffic from us-east → eu-west | Miles Thornton | | | NOT_STARTED | failoverctl execute --policy <id> | Record execution id |
| E1-06 | Execution | Verify routing changed as expected (config propagation) | Mina Haddad | | | NOT_STARTED | Check routing table diff; confirm only allowlist routes | Capture diff summary |
| E1-07 | Execution | Confirm Hosted API impact within success bounds (goal: < 1% elevated 5xx for canary tenants; p99 within +25%) | Allison Grant | | | NOT_STARTED | Queries:
- http_5xx_rate{tenant_tier="canary"}
- tail_latency_p99{region="eu-west"}
- redirect_rate{client="sdk"} | Note anomalies |
| E1-08 | Execution | Confirm Dedicated drain/evac not triggered unless explicitly in scenario (default: no drain) | Irene Choi | | | NOT_STARTED | dedicated_drain_state{region="us-east"} == "IDLE" | Avoid accidental drains |
| E1-09 | Execution | Confirm overload controls active: retry-after responses seen (if overload) and no runaway retries | Peter Holtz | | | NOT_STARTED | Sample responses; gateway metric retry_after_count | Paste sample headers |
| E1-10 | Execution | Confirm incident-bot posts failover summary + links | Devon Price | | | NOT_STARTED | Bot message link: ______ | Ensure audit id included |
| E1-11 | Execution | Add dashboard annotation "FAILOVER_EXECUTED" | Sergio Costa | | | NOT_STARTED | Annotation includes execution id + reason | For postmortem timeline |

| V1-01 | Validation | Validate steady-state after failover (5 min hold): eu-west stable, no saturation, no elevated tail | Vanessa Ortiz | | | NOT_STARTED | gpu_queue_depth, gpu_util, saturation metrics | Watch headroom |
| V1-02 | Validation | Validate region health aggregator output for us-east shows impaired; eu-west healthy | Jordan Lee | | | NOT_STARTED | region_health{region="us-east"} == DEGRADED; {region="eu-west"} == HEALTHY | Include TTL value |
| V1-03 | Validation | Validate client streaming reconnect behavior (if tested): no duplicate tool calls, idempotency preserved | Vikram Singh | | | NOT_STARTED | Check streaming reconnect logs; client error rate | Link ticket SUP-25322 if relevant |
| V1-04 | Validation | Confirm no unexpected traffic shift for non-canary tenants | Mina Haddad | | | NOT_STARTED | req_rate{tenant_tier!="canary"} unchanged; policy flips count stable | Must be true |
| V1-05 | Validation | Confirm alerting behavior: detection alert fired; no paging storm; annotations visible | Tomáš Novák | | | NOT_STARTED | Alert timeline; paging recipients | Note any noise |

| RB-01 | Rollback (planned) | Remove induced impairment in us-east (restore connectivity) | Vikram Singh | | | NOT_STARTED | Verify reachability probes return OK | Record restoration time |
| RB-02 | Rollback (planned) | Observe recovery signals (hold-down respected; no oscillation) | Miles Thornton | | | NOT_STARTED | Confirm anti-flap timers; no rapid flips | Note timer expirations |
| RB-03 | Rollback (planned) | Execute rollback to primary routing (return canary traffic to us-east) OR allow auto-rollback per policy | Miles Thornton | | | NOT_STARTED | failoverctl rollback --execution <id> | Record rollback id |
| RB-04 | Rollback (planned) | Validate us-east stable post-rollback (5 min): error/latency back to baseline | Allison Grant | | | NOT_STARTED | Baseline vs now comparison queries | Note deltas |
| RB-05 | Rollback (planned) | Confirm controller returns to monitoring state; no stuck degraded state | Jordan Lee | | | NOT_STARTED | Controller status page; last decision time | Screenshot |
| RB-06 | Rollback (planned) | Add dashboard annotation "GAME_DAY_END" | Sergio Costa | | | NOT_STARTED | Annotation includes final state + rollback id |  |

| PC-01 | Post | Collect key timestamps (impairment start, detect, approve, flip, stabilize, rollback) | Talia Benson | | | NOT_STARTED | Paste final timeline into ENG-2421 | Required deliverable |
| PC-02 | Post | Capture success criteria results (detection + failover time, customer-visible impact, SLO burn) | Aisha Bello | | | NOT_STARTED | SLO burn query: multi_region_availability_burn | Record numbers |
| PC-03 | Post | File follow-up issues for anything confusing/slow/noisy (include log links) | Rafael Mendes | | | NOT_STARTED | Create issues under ENG-2426 | Triage priority |
| PC-04 | Post | Send summary to stakeholders (VP Infra & Reliability, SRE leadership, Routing leads) | Sean Gallagher | | | NOT_STARTED | Email/slack summary link | Include major learnings |


ROLLBACK TRIGGERS (hard stop — execute rollback immediately)
- Canary tenant 5xx > 2% sustained for > 3 minutes after failover execution
- eu-west saturation indicates risk of cascading overload (gpu_queue_depth above redline OR headroom below threshold for > 2 minutes)
- Non-canary tenants affected (any measurable traffic shift or elevated error rate)
- Failover-controller crash / stuck state / repeated flip attempts (oscillation)
- Networking symptoms suggest global routing instability (not isolated to us-east)


QUICK REFERENCE — common queries (paste into your metrics UI)
- Detection latency:
  - failover_event{type="detected",region="us-east"} - impairment_marker{region="us-east"}
- Failover completion latency:
  - failover_event{type="executed",region="us-east"} - failover_event{type="detected",region="us-east"}
- Customer impact (canary):
  - sum(rate(http_requests_total{tier="canary",code=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{tier="canary"}[1m]))
- Tail latency (p99):
  - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{tier="canary"}[5m])) by (le))
- Capacity:
  - fleet_headroom{region="eu-west"}
  - gpu_queue_depth{region="eu-west"}
- Policy flips / anti-flap:
  - failover_policy_flip_total{region="us-east"}


OPEN QUESTIONS (leave notes here)
- Did corroboration signals behave as expected (reachability + 5xx burn)? Any false positives?
- Were TTL/caching behaviors (region health TTL, DNS TTL) consistent with expectations?
- Any confusing UI/tooling points for approvals, audit ids, or "why" explanations?
- Do we need a smaller blast radius for next game day (single model, single route)?
